archiveShaPolicy: The exact archive SHA-256 is recorded in the external CLOSEOUT_PERF_A3_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json and .sha256 sidecar after the immutable ZIP is created; embedding an archive hash inside the same archive is self-referential.
packageTreeHashScope: All package files except this package manifest, external release manifest/final-verification, and nested *.zip artifacts. Historical *.zip.sha256 sidecars are included.
freshExtractVerificationPolicy: The immutable final ZIP is verified after creation; authoritative result is recorded externally in CLOSEOUT_PERF_A3_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json and CLOSEOUT_PERF_A3_FINAL_ZIP_VERIFICATION.json.
